Each chain bridge crosses a cut with 10k vertices on one side, so no perfect matching uses bridges. Therefore all product decompositions and VC/Ldim formulas for arbitrary positive s follow by proof, not finite extrapolation. Graph properties are checked constructively. Replayed standalone verifier checks the exact local traces and all 24 certificate constraints.

value.rationale: The first threshold at five ladder columns is motivated by classic domino tilings, rather than an arbitrary small hypergraph. Only eight matchings already separate static and adaptive shattering, and the reason is a derived vertical-edge NOR query that boosts adaptive but not static dimension. Parity-forbidden bridges then amplify the exact 2-versus-3 dimensions to an unbounded gap on connected planar subcubic bipartite perfect-matching classes; this is a substantive structural learning phenomenon not supplied by the tiling count alone.
